scientific_integrity: Finite enumeration is supporting evidence, not proof of the infinite formula. The minimum rook-graph value was known previously; only the enumerative refinement is claimed here.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for line graphs of finite complete multipartite graphs with at least two nonempty parts; it makes no complexity claim for variable part count and no priority or independent verification claim. The 2014 original rook-graph scalar theorem could be assessed only through accessible excerpts and its treatment in a subsequent full-text source.
title: Residual-forest characterization and power-domination polynomials for multipartite line graphs
